input.quote: 8.2 Exclusivity of Efforts. Prior to the [ * ], neither Ono or its Affiliates, nor Array or its Controlled Affiliates, shall Commercialize in the Ono Territory:
input.rationale: Section 8.2 imposes an exclusive-dealing covenant on Ono (and its Affiliates), barring Commercialization of any Competing Product in the Ono Territory for an undefined, redacted period, plus a post-termination tail running to the [ * ] anniversary of termination. The covenant is limited to a defined product category (the "Competing Product" definition), satisfying the first fallback element, but it exceeds 12 months and gives Ono no automatic exit for Array's supply failures — Ono's only relief is if Array itself commercializes a Competing Product. That is walk-away territory (exclusive dealing for the full term with no performance-based exit), so we redline to the fallback. The added exit is now anchored self-executingly in Array's own Article 9 supply obligations under this Agreement (including any agreed service levels or delivery dates, and any supply agreement entered into pursuant to Article 9), so it operates whether or not a separate supply agreement is executed. Article IX is not a second exclusivity: Section 9.4(a) expressly gives Ono the right (but not the obligation) to Manufacture or engage a Subcontractor, so Ono remains free to use alternatives. Array's reciprocal covenant benefits Ono and is preserved; we conformed only Array's Section 8.2 termination trigger so it cannot bite after the capped covenant expires, keeping the Article XIV cross-reference intact.

proposal.summary: Cap Ono's Section 8.2 non-compete at 12 months and end it automatically on Array's failure to meet service levels or delivery dates under Article 9; conform Array's termination trigger.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 8.2 binds Ono to an open-ended non-compete with no performance-based exit, so we capped Ono's side at twelve (12) months and made it end automatically if Array misses service levels or delivery dates under its Article 9 supply obligations. Array's reciprocal covenant is untouched, and we conformed Array's termination trigger to the capped covenant.

ops.text: The obligations of Ono and its Affiliates under this Section 8.2 shall in no event continue beyond the twelve (12) month anniversary of the Effective Date, and shall terminate automatically if Array fails to meet its supply obligations under Article 9 of this Agreement, including any service levels or delivery dates agreed by the Parties or set forth in any supply agreement entered into pursuant to Article 9.

ops.oldText: If Ono Commercializes a Competing Product in the Ono Territory during [ * ], Array may immediately terminate this Agreement.
ops.newText: If Ono Commercializes a Competing Product in the Ono Territory in breach of this Section 8.2, Array may immediately terminate this Agreement.

mappings.element: Exclusivity is limited to a defined product category.
mappings.quote: (i) a product that includes, as an active pharmaceutical ingredient, an agent that is a [ * ] (other than Binimetinib), or (ii) a product that includes, as an active pharmaceutical ingredient, an agent that is a [ * ] (other than Encorafenib), or grant the right to a licensee or distributor to Commercialize in the Ono Territory any of the above described products (each a "Competing Product").

mappings.element: Exclusivity lasts no longer than 12 months.
Exclusivity ends automatically if Vendor fails to meet service levels.
Exclusivity ends automatically if Vendor fails to meet delivery dates.
